description: tangent-cylinders-cut's tool, touching the target along a ruling from outside, moved four tolerances (4e-7) across the contact, into the target (d > 0) and away from it (d < 0): the target less a sliver, and the target whole. A quarter of a tolerance is tangent-cylinders-a-quarter-off (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 9, the band's ends).
